name: vortex-notes
description: Markdown notes with a first-party MCP server and zero-config local semantic search. The vault your agents can actually use.

scripts.build: tsc && npm run build:web && npm run build:assets
scripts.build:assets: mkdir -p dist/assets/icons dist/assets/geo && cp assets/demo.svg dist/assets/demo.svg && cp assets/icons/*.png dist/assets/icons/ && cp assets/geo/country.mmdb dist/assets/geo/
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node test/e2e-webapp.mjs && node test/e2e-lock.mjs && node test/e2e-public.mjs && node test/e2e-usermenu.mjs && node test/e2e-session.mjs && node test/e2e-connector.mjs && node test/e2e-landing.mjs && node test/e2e-oauth.mjs && node test/e2e-richedit.mjs
scripts.cf:dev: npm run build:cf && cd deploy/cf && npx wrangler dev --env dev --port 8788
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run build:cf && cd deploy/cf && npx wrangler deploy --env= && cd pages && npx wrangler pages deploy --project-name vortex-notes --branch main --commit-dirty=true
